descriptions.inProgress: I can't believe that The Nautilus' power is generated by this mystical Shining Stone... That's pretty interesting, I must say. I wonder what the Shining Stone looks like. I should go check out the stone in #bThe Nautilus' Generator Room#k.
descriptions.completed: While I was touching the Shining Stone, I could actually feel the stone's mystical powers traveling through my entire body.
